title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Review: The 201g Gamble
alt_titles: Galaxy Z Fold 8: Lightest Fold Ever, But At What Cost?
Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 vs Z Fold 8 Ultra: Don't Buy the Wrong One
description:
Samsung unveiled the Galaxy Z Fold 8 with a brand-new 4:3 aspect ratio, weighing just 201g. We break down whether this lightweight tablet-style foldable is worth $1,899.99 or if you should hold out for the Ultra.

Sources:
- Mashable: https://mashable.com/tech/samsung-galaxy-z-fold-8-launch-price-specifications
- Samsung Global Newsroom: https://news.samsung.com/global/samsung-galaxy-z-fold8-ultra-fold8-and-flip8foldables-perfected-for-every-way-of-living
- The Verge: https://www.theverge.com/2022/8/10/23300215/samsung-galaxy-z-fold-4-foldable-phone-killer-app

scenes.narration: Samsung just completely changed the formula for its flagship foldable, making it shorter, wider, and lighter than ever before. But to hit a record-breaking 201 grams, they made a tradeoff that might split power users right down the middle.
scenes.heading: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8

scenes.narration: This is the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8. By the end of this video, you will know whether this brand-new 4:3 aspect ratio is the future of foldables or if you should spend even more on the Ultra model.
scenes.heading: Galaxy Z Fold 8

scenes.narration: At just 201 grams, this is officially Samsung's lightest Galaxy Z Fold ever. It measures an absurdly thin 4.5 millimeters unfolded, making it genuinely feel like holding a sheet of glass.
scenes.heading: World's Lightest Fold

scenes.narration: To understand why this design shift happened, look back at how we got here. Early folds suffered from display fragility, the Z Fold 2 introduced UTG and outer cover screens, and now the Fold 8 completely shifts to a 4:3 aspect ratio.
scenes.heading: Evolution of the Fold

scenes.narration: Crucially, the Z Fold 8 is not a direct replacement for the Z Fold 7. Samsung split the lineup this year, targeting the standard Fold 8 at readers and everyday multitaskers while pushing heavy pro users toward the Z Fold 8 Ultra.
scenes.heading: Lineup Split

scenes.narration: How did they make the screen crease almost invisible? It starts with the Armor Flexhinge mechanism, layered over Flex Titanium structural support, which flattens the inner 7.6-inch AMOLED display completely under light.
scenes.heading: Crease Elimination

scenes.narration: Under the hood, you get the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 processor, base 12GB RAM with options up to 16GB, and a 4,800mAh battery powering both the inner display and the 5.5-inch outer cover screen.
scenes.heading: Key Specifications

scenes.narration: Samsung's official announcement highlights how deep the software integration goes, combining partner tools like Gemini Intelligence with features like My Fancam for AI subject tracking.
scenes.heading: Galaxy AI & Gemini

scenes.narration: Where the compromises hit hardest is the camera setup. You get a 50MP wide, 50MP ultrawide, and a 10MP selfie shooter, but there is no dedicated telephoto lens at all.
scenes.heading: Camera Setup

scenes.narration: For social media and quick clips with 8K recording at 30fps, it performs well. But compared to traditional Ultra bar phones, you are missing out on maximum zoom capabilities.
When you record video using the new My Fancam feature, the system tracks your subject, applies AI cropping, and automatically formats the output for vertical video feeds.
scenes.heading: My Fancam AI

scenes.narration: Then there is the price tag. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 starts at $1,899.99 for 256GB of storage, though Amazon pre-orders launched with a discount down to $1,699.99.
scenes.heading: Starting Price

scenes.narration: This wider form factor also positions Samsung directly against Apple's expected shorter, wider iPhone foldable. If you want a pocketable tablet experience, this 4:3 shape is clearly where the industry is heading.
scenes.heading: Market Comparison

scenes.narration: By splitting the Z Fold lineup into standard and Ultra tiers, Samsung gave everyday multitaskers the ultimate lightweight foldable, but forced serious camera enthusiasts to pay even more.
scenes.heading: Samsung's decision to split the line gives multitaskers a lighter body, but power users must pay more for Ultra.

scenes.narration: The Galaxy Z Fold 8 is a triumph in hardware ergonomics, even if the camera cuts hurt. Hit subscribe for more honest tech breakdowns, and I will see you in the next one.
